subject.title: Bug: Agent outputs ~ tilde shorthand instead of full absolute file paths

question: Should OpenClaw change the canonical agent-visible path display policy from compact home-relative paths to full absolute paths, and on which surfaces should that apply?
rationale: Current source and tests intentionally preserve `~/...`, the direct env-var PR was closed unmerged, and the merged related PR fixed only malformed sibling-prefix shortening; choosing a broader path policy is maintainer product direction, not a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Define full-path copy surfaces
options.body: Use full absolute paths for copy-pasteable file references while keeping compact/redacted paths only where privacy or diagnostic readability requires them.

options.title: Keep compact display
options.body: Treat `~/...` as intended UI compaction and close or re-scope this issue to only malformed path rendering bugs.

options.title: Add an opt-in mode
options.body: Add a documented config/env flag for full paths, accepting the extra configuration surface and upgrade/docs burden.

recommendation.title: Define full-path copy surfaces
recommendation.body: Use full absolute paths for copy-pasteable file references while keeping compact/redacted paths only where privacy or diagnostic readability requires them.

likelyOwner.reason: The central shared display helpers and tool-display metadata history point to Peter Steinberger as the best available routing candidate for a cross-surface display-policy decision.
